artworks.title: Cadmus Goes in Search of His Sister Europa
artworks.description: Ovidian print of Cadmus' quest: Agenor's command that his sons find Europa or not return — the Phoenician king's order that empties Tyre and founds Thebes.

artworks.title: Phoenix, Son of Agenor
artworks.description: Print titled Phoenix Agenor filius — Agenor's son as the eponym of Phoenicia, proof of the Tyrian house the father ruled.

artworks.title: The Abduction of Europa
artworks.description: Rembrandt's Europa on the bull — Agenor's daughter stolen from Phoenicia, the loss that sends Cadmus west under the king's decree.

popCulture.title: Agenor
popCulture.description: Mythical Phoenician king, husband of Telephassa, father of Europa, Cadmus, Phoenix and Cilix — not the many lesser Agenors of Argos, Troy or Ithaca.

popCulture.title: Europa (consort of Zeus)
popCulture.description: Agenor's daughter — the princess Zeus carries to Crete, whose abduction empties her father's house.

popCulture.title: Cadmus
popCulture.description: Agenor's son — the brother who obeys the search-order and founds Thebes when Europa cannot be found.
